scope: Sum of GitHub stars and default-branch commits across Phantom ecosystem repos (ecosystem/repos.json).

repos.description: Phantom by AshlrAI: an open-source engineering agent workbench for Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Grok and local models. Connect your resources, work with agents, or run an autonomous fleet.
Stop AI coding agents from leaking your API keys. Local proxy + MCP that swaps real secrets for phm_ tokens — works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Codex.
Identity plane for coding agents — wrong account, impossible. Multi-account MCP/CLI bindings so agents never act in the wrong tenant.
A personal lexicon for voice-to-agents. One YAML file of the words speech-to-text gets wrong, applied everywhere your voice lands: MCP, Claude Code, the browser, macOS.
An open-source, AI-native Markdown app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Open any .md and it's instantly beautiful, with free on-device AI and agent (MCP) integration.
Provision and connect development services through CLI and MCP tools, with Phantom for credential handling.
Token-efficiency plugin for Claude Code and Codex: MCP tools and hooks that replace high-volume Read/Grep/Edit/Bash calls with compact equivalents, powered by @ashlr/core-efficiency.
Token-efficiency primitives for Claude Code: genome, compression, provider-aware budgeting.
Supply-chain security for npm and PyPI: scans install scripts and native binaries (Ghidra decompilation, YARA, AI classification), checks OSV malware advisories, and gates PRs with a GitHub Action.
Homebrew tap for Locus and Ashlr tools
